# Wait Behaviour

Source: [4854](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4854); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4854-n1"></a>

- Abort When False aborts when any rule condition becomes false; Ignore Condition does not interrupt the action list.

<a id="wiki-4854-n2"></a>

- Restart When True restarts at the first action on a false-to-true condition transition or a repeated event with true conditions.
